title: mail: Email/get implementation
description:
Implement Email/get in crates/mail/src/email/get.rs: for each requested id (CID string), parse CID, fetch ArticleRootNode from IPFS via IpfsBlockStore, map to Email object using Email::from_root_node(). Return #not-found for CIDs not in IPFS. Support properties filter (only return requested fields to reduce payload).

Why: Email/get is how clients fetch full message content; it must round-trip through IPFS correctly.

Acceptance: after POST via reader, Email/get by that article's CID returns a valid Email with correct subject and body.
